create_command_subclass: create a Command subclass with register and run methods for a TRL CLI subcommand
build_command_context: build a CommandContext with argv list to pass to CLI command run methods
run_command_execute: run a Command subclass by calling register to add a subparser and run with args and context
test_command_context_argv_after: test the CommandContext.argv_after method to extract tokens after a subcommand token
review_command_base_class: review the Command base class for abstract register and run methods in TRL CLI
